bugs_found.description: Missing explicit $dumpflush call prior to $finish could lead to incomplete VCD trace buffer flushing under certain EDA simulators.
bugs_found.fix_applied: Added explicit $dumpflush; and verified $fclose(f_csv) execution prior to $finish.

bugs_found.description: Whitespace padding in Verilog $fdisplay header caused space-prefixed dictionary keys during CSV reading.
bugs_found.fix_applied: Applied key.strip() and val.strip() dictionary comprehension across CSV parsing backends.

bugs_found.description: Hardcoded backslash path separators could cause path resolution failures on POSIX/Linux systems.
bugs_found.fix_applied: Refactored all path manipulations to use pathlib.Path objects.

optimizations_applied.optimization: Placed (* KEEP = 'TRUE', DONT_TOUCH = 'TRUE' *) synthesis attributes directly preceding wire declarations to guarantee Vivado xvlog syntax compatibility.
Implemented streaming generator-based line-by-line VCD file reading to keep RAM footprint low (<50 MB) on large waveform traces.
Added zero-division floating-point epsilon padding (+ 1e-6) to frequency_ratio calculation.
Implemented dual ML execution engine (scikit-learn with fallback to pure-Python Decision Tree/Random Forest) for 100% environment portability.
Parameterized Vdd drift (+-5%) and Gaussian thermal jitter (sigma=2.0) with deterministic random seed support.
